verdict.rationale: The README documents an in-agent marketplace install (`/plugin marketplace add` followed by `/plugin install`). It also states that after starting a new session the agent picks the skill up from its description, which covers activation in the next session. Missing for 10: a true single-command install (the marketplace path needs two commands), and independent or hands-on confirmation that the install works as documented.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install a skill collection with one documented command — a package-manager one-liner, CLI, or in-agent marketplace command — and it is active in my next session

citations.quote: Start a new session and ask for a logo; the agent picks the skill up from its description.
